title: Planning a class party
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear Linh talking to her friend Jack about a class party.
Jack, have you got a minute? I want to talk about the end of term party.
Sure. Are we having it at school again?
The school hall is free, but it's a bit boring. My uncle has a restaurant with a big room upstairs. He says we can use it.
That's great. What about the date? Most people finish their tests on the twelfth.
So the thirteenth is a Friday. But my uncle's restaurant is very busy on Fridays. Let's say Saturday the fourteenth.
OK. And food? Pizza is easy.
My uncle will cook for us. He'll make noodles and spring rolls, and it's only five dollars each.
Cheaper than pizza! What can I do to help?
Could you make a list of songs? Minh offered to play music, but he only likes rock.
Ha, yes. I'll do that. And should we invite the teachers?
Just Ms Anh. She's been our class teacher for three years. The head teacher is away that week.

items.q: Where will the party be?

ev.s: My uncle has a restaurant with a big room upstairs.

items.why: Họ dùng phòng trên lầu nhà hàng của chú Linh.

wrong.B: Không ai đề nghị tổ chức ở nhà Linh.
wrong.C: Hội trường trống nhưng Linh thấy chán.

items.q: When will the party be?

ev.s: Let's say Saturday the fourteenth.

items.why: Chốt thứ Bảy ngày mười bốn.

wrong.A: Ngày mười hai là ngày thi xong.
wrong.C: Ngày mười ba là thứ Sáu, nhà hàng đông khách.

items.q: What food will they have?

ev.s: My uncle will cook for us.

items.why: Chú của Linh sẽ nấu mì và nem.

wrong.A: Không ai nói học sinh mang đồ ăn.
wrong.B: Jack gợi ý pizza nhưng đồ chú nấu rẻ hơn.

items.q: What will Jack do?

opts.t: bring a speaker for the music
ask Minh to play his rock songs

ev.s: Could you make a list of songs?

items.why: Jack sẽ làm danh sách bài hát.

wrong.B: Không ai nhắc mang loa.
wrong.C: Linh không muốn nhạc rock của Minh.

items.q: Who will they invite?

opts.t: Ms Anh and the head teacher

ev.s: Just Ms Anh.

items.why: Chỉ mời cô Anh, giáo viên chủ nhiệm.

wrong.A: Linh nói chỉ cô Anh.
wrong.C: Thầy hiệu trưởng đi vắng.

title: Buying a present
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear Tom talking to his mum about a present for his grandfather.
Tom, it's Grandpa's seventieth birthday on Sunday. Have you thought about a present?
I wanted to buy him a book about birds, but he's got so many already.
What about a new watch? His old one is broken.
Aunt Hoa is buying him a watch. I know because she told me last week.
Oh, OK. Well, he loves gardening. You could get him some new gloves.
That's a good idea, but I'd like to make something myself. Maybe a photo album with old family photos?
He'd love that! Aunt Hoa has some photos too, but she lives too far away. I've got lots of old photos in the cupboard. You can use them.
Great. When should I start?
Today, if you can. We're leaving for Grandpa's house on Saturday morning.
I'll need to buy an album. Is the shop near the post office open on Thursdays?
It closes early on Thursdays. Go on Friday after school.

items.q: Why doesn't Tom buy a book?

opts.t: His grandfather can't see very well now.
Tom couldn't find one in the shop.
His grandfather already has lots of them.

ev.s: he's got so many already

items.why: Ông đã có rất nhiều sách về chim.

wrong.A: Không ai nói mắt ông kém.
wrong.B: Tom không nói đi tìm sách ở cửa hàng.

items.q: Who is buying a watch?

ev.s: Aunt Hoa is buying him a watch.

items.why: Dì Hoa sẽ mua đồng hồ.

wrong.A: Mẹ chỉ gợi ý mua đồng hồ.
wrong.B: Tom biết dì Hoa đã mua nên không mua.

items.q: What present will Tom give?

ev.s: I'd like to make something myself.

items.why: Tom muốn tự làm một cuốn album ảnh.

wrong.B: Găng tay là ý của mẹ; Tom muốn tự làm quà.
wrong.C: Dì Hoa mua đồng hồ.

items.q: Where will Tom get the photos?

ev.s: I've got lots of old photos in the cupboard.

items.why: Mẹ có nhiều ảnh cũ trong tủ.

wrong.A: Dì Hoa có ảnh nhưng ở xa.
wrong.B: Không ai nhắc lấy ảnh trên mạng.

items.q: When will Tom go to the shop?

ev.s: Go on Friday after school.

items.why: Mẹ bảo đi chiều thứ Sáu sau giờ học.

wrong.A: Thứ Năm cửa hàng đóng cửa sớm.
wrong.C: Sáng thứ Bảy cả nhà đi đến nhà ông.

title: A new hobby
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear Anna talking to her friend Sam about a new hobby.
Anna, you look tired. Did you go out last night?
No, I was at my new climbing class. It finished at nine.
Climbing? I thought you were doing yoga.
I was, but the teacher moved to another city. My brother suggested climbing. He goes every week.
Is it difficult?
Very! My arms hurt this morning. But the worst thing is that I'm a bit afraid of being high up. I didn't look down once!
Ha! How much does it cost?
I've only been twice, and the first month is free. After that it's twenty dollars a month, or five dollars a class. The shoes are expensive, but you can borrow them at the centre.
Maybe I'll try it. When do they have classes?
There's one on Tuesday evening and one on Sunday morning. I go on Tuesdays because I work on Sundays.
Sunday is better for me. Can you give me the phone number?

items.q: Why did Anna stop doing yoga?

opts.t: She hurt her back doing yoga.
The yoga class became too expensive.

ev.s: the teacher moved to another city

items.why: Cô giáo yoga chuyển đến thành phố khác.

wrong.A: Anna không nói bị đau lưng.
wrong.C: Anna không nói lớp yoga đắt lên.

items.q: What does Anna find hardest about climbing?

ev.s: the worst thing is that I'm a bit afraid of being high up

items.why: Điều tệ nhất là cô hơi sợ độ cao.

wrong.B: Không ai nói về leo nhanh.
wrong.C: Tay cô đau, nhưng cô nói điều tệ nhất là sợ độ cao.

items.q: How much does Anna pay now?

ev.s: the first month is free

items.why: Anna mới đi hai buổi, tháng đầu miễn phí.

wrong.A: Hai mươi đô là giá từ tháng thứ hai.
wrong.C: Năm đô một buổi là cách trả khác, sau tháng đầu.

items.q: When does Anna go to her class?

ev.s: I go on Tuesdays because I work on Sundays.

items.why: Anna đi vào tối thứ Ba.

wrong.B: Chủ nhật cô đi làm; Sam mới chọn Chủ nhật.
wrong.C: Anna chỉ đi thứ Ba.

items.q: What does Sam ask for?

ev.s: Can you give me the phone number?

items.why: Sam xin số điện thoại.

wrong.A: Sam không hỏi địa chỉ.
wrong.B: Giày mượn được ở trung tâm; Sam không xin.

title: Finding a flat
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear Minh talking to his friend Kate about finding a flat.
How's the flat hunting going, Minh?
Not great. I saw three flats yesterday. The first one was lovely, but it was too far from my office.
How far?
An hour by bus. The second one was close to work, but it was really dark. It had only one small window.
And the third?
The third one is near the park. It's quite small, but it's bright and the rent is OK. I think I'll take it.
Is there a kitchen?
Just a small one. You can't see the park from the windows, but there's a big balcony, so I can have breakfast outside.
When can you move in?
The owner said the first of next month. But I need a bed. My old one belongs to my landlord now.
My sister is selling her bed. It's almost new. I'll ask her.
Thanks, Kate. That would really help. I'll invite you both for dinner when I move in.

items.q: What was the problem with the first flat?

opts.t: The rent was too high for him.
It was a long way from Minh's work.

ev.s: it was too far from my office

items.why: Căn đầu đi xe buýt mất một giờ đến chỗ làm.

wrong.A: Căn thứ hai mới tối.
wrong.B: Không ai chê giá căn đầu.

items.q: Which flat will Minh take?

opts.t: the one with a big kitchen

ev.s: The third one is near the park.

items.why: Minh chọn căn gần công viên.

wrong.A: Căn tối là căn thứ hai, Minh không chọn.
wrong.C: Căn Minh chọn chỉ có bếp nhỏ.

items.q: What does Minh like about the new flat?

ev.s: there's a big balcony, so I can have breakfast outside

items.why: Ban công lớn, có thể ăn sáng ngoài trời.

wrong.B: Không ai nhắc con phố yên tĩnh.
wrong.C: Từ cửa sổ không nhìn thấy công viên.

items.q: What does Minh need to buy?

ev.s: But I need a bed.

items.why: Minh cần một chiếc giường.

wrong.B: Cửa sổ là chuyện căn thứ hai.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc bàn.

items.q: What will Kate do?

ev.s: I'll ask her.

items.why: Kate sẽ hỏi chị gái về chiếc giường.

wrong.A: Kate không nói giúp chuyển nhà.
wrong.B: Minh đã chọn được căn hộ.

title: A school project
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear two students, Hai and Emma, talking about a school project.
Hai, we need to choose a topic for our science project. Have you got any ideas?
What about the weather? My dad has a small weather station in our garden.
Lots of people did that last year. I'd like to do something about plastic in the sea.
Hmm, that's interesting, but it's a big topic. What about plastic in our school?
Yes! We could count the plastic bottles in the bins for a week.
Good. When can we meet to plan it? I'm busy on Monday and Wednesday.
I've got a piano lesson on Thursday. Tuesday, then?
Tuesday's fine. Where? The library is always noisy after school.
We can go to my house. My mum won't mind.
Great. And how long does the project need to be? Ten pages?
The teacher said six pages, with some photos. We have to finish it by the end of May.

items.q: Why doesn't Emma want to study the weather?

opts.t: Hai's dad would do all the work.
It is too difficult to measure.

ev.s: Lots of people did that last year.

items.why: Năm ngoái nhiều người đã làm đề tài này.

wrong.A: Không ai nói bố Hải sẽ làm hộ.
wrong.C: Emma không nói nó khó đo.

items.q: What will their project be about?

ev.s: What about plastic in our school?

items.why: Họ chọn đề tài nhựa trong trường.

wrong.A: Hải thấy đề tài biển quá rộng.
wrong.B: Không ai nhắc rác ở công viên.

items.q: When will they meet?

ev.s: Tuesday, then?

items.why: Họ hẹn thứ Ba.

wrong.B: Hải bận thứ Hai.
wrong.C: Emma học đàn thứ Năm.

items.q: Where will they meet?

ev.s: We can go to my house.

items.why: Họ gặp ở nhà Emma.

wrong.A: Nhà Hải có trạm thời tiết, nhưng không phải chỗ hẹn.
wrong.C: Thư viện ồn sau giờ học.

items.q: How long must the project be?

ev.s: The teacher said six pages

items.why: Cô giáo yêu cầu sáu trang.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc tám trang.
wrong.B: Mười trang là Hải đoán.

title: Weekend plans
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear a conversation.

script.t: You will hear Ngoc talking to her friend Ben about the weekend.
Any plans for the weekend, Ngoc?
I wanted to go to the beach with my cousins, but they can't come now. So I might stay in the city.
There's a food festival in the park on Saturday. Do you want to come with me?
I'd love to. What time does it start?
It opens at ten, but I've got a tennis match in the morning. Can we meet at one?
That's fine. Should I bring some money? Is it expensive?
Last year it was five dollars to go in, but this year it's free to go in. Each dish costs about three dollars.
OK. How are you getting there? By bike?
I usually cycle, but there's nowhere to leave bikes there. Let's take the bus. It stops right in front of the park.
Good. And on Sunday I need to study. I've got an English test on Monday.
Me too! Shall we study together in the afternoon?
Yes, let's do that. Come to my house at two.

items.q: Why isn't Ngoc going to the beach?

ev.s: they can't come now

items.why: Anh chị em họ không đi được nữa.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc thời tiết.
wrong.C: Ngọc không nói phải đi làm.

items.q: What time will they meet on Saturday?

ev.s: Can we meet at one?

items.why: Họ hẹn lúc một giờ.

wrong.A: Mười giờ là giờ lễ hội mở cửa.
wrong.B: Buổi sáng Ben có trận tennis.

items.q: How much does it cost to go into the festival?

ev.s: this year it's free to go in

items.why: Vào cửa miễn phí.

wrong.A: Năm đô là giá vào cửa năm ngoái.
wrong.C: Ba đô là giá mỗi món ăn.

items.q: How will they travel to the park?

ev.s: Let's take the bus.

items.why: Họ đi xe buýt vì ở đó không có chỗ để xe đạp.

wrong.B: Không ai nói đi bộ.
wrong.C: Ben thường đạp xe nhưng lần này thì không.

items.q: What will they do on Sunday?

ev.s: Yes, let's do that.

items.why: Ben rủ học bài cùng chiều Chủ nhật.

wrong.B: Tennis là sáng thứ Bảy.
wrong.C: Chuyến biển bị huỷ.
